title: Closing apps
drDigitalIntro:
To close an app window, click the X button at the top-right corner of the window.
• This removes the window from your screen.
• Warning: on a real computer, Ctrl+Q or Cmd+Q quits the app immediately. Do not press those keys right now.
• The minus (−) button is different — it minimizes the window (hides it without closing it).
• Close the window below with the X button.

steps.say: Click the X button to close this window.

drDigitalSuccess: The X closes the window. It sits in the same corner of every window you will ever meet.
drDigitalHint: Look for the X at the top-right corner of the window. It turns red when you point at it.
